name: 风云Ⅳ — fengyun434
english_description: Produced by Sumxin's Fengyun studio, part of this project's "Fengyun" wuxia engine family shared with fy2, fy2005, fy2qh, fy3xd, and fy3dz — each a separate content branch from a different site or era built on the same core engine. Set in a jianghu drawn from Gu Long's wuxia novels, players begin as an ordinary commoner just entering the martial world, choosing an ethnicity (Han, Miao, Manchu, or Mongol) that shapes starting attributes and birthplace.
